notes: StrataIMD is the fixed-supply ERC-20 in src/StrataIMD.sol. Its argument-free constructor mints 1,000,000,000 STRATA with 18 decimals once to msg.sender. There are no application contracts or initialization calls. The pool uses the requested paired token, a 0.3% fee, and tick spacing 60. initialPrice is provenance only: floor(sqrt(initialMarketCapWei / totalSupply) * 2^96), expressed with STRATA as currency0 and the paired token as currency1. The deployer derives the actual opening price from the supplied economics and totalSupply using the deployed currency ordering.
